items.title: Booking Holdings issues €3.55B in senior notes across four tranches
items.summary: Booking Holdings Inc. executed four Officers' Certificates on November 13, 2026 to issue €1.25B of 3.950% Senior Notes due 2029, €800M of 4.375% Senior Notes due 2032, €750M of 4.750% Senior Notes due 2035, and €750M of 5.000% Senior Notes due 2038. The notes are senior unsecured obligations with interest payable annually beginning November 13, 2027, and the company has redemption rights under specified conditions.

items.title: Apollo Global Management issues $600 million in junior subordinated notes
items.summary: Apollo Global Management issued $600 million aggregate principal amount of 7.550% Fixed-Rate Resettable Junior Subordinated Notes due 2056 on November 13, 2026. The notes will bear a fixed rate of 7.550% until December 15, 2036, then reset to the Five-Year U.S. Treasury Rate plus 2.672%. The company intends to use net proceeds for general corporate purposes, including to fund a previously announced investment in Mubadala Capital Asset Management.

items.title: Qualcomm issues $3.75B in senior unsecured notes across five tranches
items.summary: Qualcomm Incorporated executed an Officers' Certificate on November 12, 2026 to issue $3.75B in aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes in a registered public offering. The notes comprise five series maturing between 2028 and 2036 with interest rates ranging from 5.000% to 5.800% per year, payable semiannually beginning May 20, 2027.

items.title: Emerson Electric completes €750 million offering of 4% notes due 2032
items.summary: Emerson Electric Co. completed a public offering of €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.000% Notes due 2032 on November 13, 2026. The notes are senior unsecured obligations that will rank equally with the company's existing and future unsecured and unsubordinated debt. Interest is payable annually on November 13, beginning November 13, 2027, and the notes mature on November 13, 2032.

items.title: TKO Group Holdings issues $1.0 billion of senior secured notes due 2031
items.summary: TKO Worldwide Holdings, an indirect subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings, issued $1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of 6.500% Senior Secured Notes due November 15, 2031, on November 13, 2026. The notes are guaranteed by TKO Guarantor LLC and wholly-owned domestic restricted subsidiaries, secured by a first priority lien on collateral securing existing senior secured credit facilities, with interest payable semiannually. TKO intends to use net proceeds for general corporate purposes, which may include distributions to fund share repurchases.

items.title: U.S. producer prices rise 0.3% in October; goods up 0.5%, services up 0.2%
items.summary: The Producer Price Index for final demand increased 0.3 percent in October 2026, seasonally adjusted, with goods prices advancing 0.5 percent and services rising 0.2 percent. On an unadjusted basis, the index for final demand increased 6.5 percent for the 12 months ended in October, the largest 12-month rise since November 2022 when it rose 7.4 percent. The index for final demand less foods, energy, and trade services rose 0.5 percent in October and advanced 4.9 percent over the 12-month period.

items.title: Vertiv Holdings raises annual dividend by 60 percent to $0.40 per share
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co raised its regular annual cash dividend by 60 percent from $0.25 to $0.40 per share, to be paid quarterly. The increase, reflecting strong financial performance and cash flow, takes effect with the fourth-quarter dividend of $0.10 per share, payable December 17, 2026.

items.title: Moody's closes €500M offering of 4.125% senior notes due 2033
items.summary: Moody's Corporation closed a public offering of €500 million aggregate principal amount of 4.125% Senior Notes due 2033 on November 12, 2026. The notes bear a fixed interest rate of 4.125% per year and mature on November 12, 2033, with annual interest payments beginning November 12, 2027. The company said net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include repayment of its 1.75% Senior Notes due 2027.

items.title: Charles Schwab issues $3B in fixed and floating rate senior notes
items.summary: The Charles Schwab Corporation issued $300M of floating rate notes due 2030, $1.3B of 5.334% fixed-to-floating rate senior notes due 2030, and $1.4B of 5.732% fixed-to-floating rate senior notes due 2034 on November 12, 2026. The offering generated net proceeds of approximately $2.98B after underwriting costs and expenses.

items.title: Federal Reserve announces 1.4 percent average price increase for payment services in 2027
items.summary: The Federal Reserve Board announced pricing effective January 1, 2027, for payment services including check clearing, ACH transactions, instant payments, and wholesale services provided to banks and credit unions. The Federal Reserve expects to recover 101.5 percent of actual and imputed expenses in 2027, with an estimated 1.4 percent average price increase for established, mature services. The Federal Reserve Banks also announced changes to streamline check services, including optimizing processing windows and increasing fees for check processing.

items.title: Federal Reserve announces 2027 FOMC meeting schedule
items.summary: The Federal Reserve announced its revised tentative schedule of Federal Open Market Committee meetings for 2027, with eight regular meetings scheduled on specified dates plus one additional meeting in January 2028. The October 26-27 meeting will be dedicated to discussing broad monetary policy strategy issues rather than making a policy decision announcement.
